name: Oc huong
summary: Ốc hương biển hấp sả is sea snail steamed with lemongrass. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng says the snail has small spots and a clean sea sweetness. A diner in the Dân Việt town story ordered ốc hương and did not name a cook. Both stay.
origin: Can Gio. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, 17 Feb 2014. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022, on the town streets, without a cook.
howToEat: The 2014 cook is steamed with lemongrass. The 2022 diner does not say how it was cooked.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The 2022 plate was on the town streets. The 2014 story names no street. The hour is Check on arrival.
